subject: Automotive & EVs
title: The Last Combustion Engine
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Last Combustion Engine usable.

hook.text: The European Union plans to ban new combustion-engine car sales by 2035.

buildup.text: China, California, and several nations announced similar deadlines within the next two decades.

discovery.text: Over a billion combustion cars run on roads today—replacing them will take many decades more.

twist.text: In many developing nations EVs remain too expensive, so combustion engines will last far longer.

climax.text: Some predict the last combustion car will be built around 2060—others say much sooner.

punchline.text: The combustion engine isn't dead yet but its retirement date is set.

quiz.question: When does the EU plan to ban new combustion-only car sales?
